title: Requirements
description: Schema for requirements.json spec artifact (format version 3)

execution_paths.description: The end-to-end paths. A full package has at least one; a lite package has none.

^x-.description: An extension key: a team's own metadata, any value, kept by every save. The format gives it no meaning.

check.description: How a criterion is verified: its own check (kind, setup, pseudocode), or the same as another criterion's check or a path's smoke check (same_as).

kind.description: unit exercises one component with its collaborators stubbed; integration two or more real components; property an invariant over an input domain.

setup.description: The preconditions the criterion's condition does not state.

pseudocode.description: Language-agnostic assertions. May name the function, file and existing test the check extends.

same_as.description: The criterion whose own check verifies this one too, or the path whose smoke check does.

^x-.description: An extension key: a team's own metadata, any value, kept by every save. The format gives it no meaning.

criterion.description: One EARS statement with its check. The rendered sentence is derived from pattern, condition, system and action.

condition.description: The WHEN / WHILE / IF / WHERE clause. Absent for ubiquitous. A second condition is written into it, joined with and.

system.description: The acting component. Defaults to the requirement's system, then to "system", when rendering.

contract.description: What the caller observes, and what the check asserts. Required for unwanted.

system.description: The acting component of every criterion that names none.

smoke.description: The smoke check of a path: it runs the path once with its real components and asserts the end state.

real_components.description: The components that must not be mocked.

end_state.description: The side effects at the end of the path.

pseudocode.description: Language-agnostic assertions. May name the existing end-to-end test the check extends.
